messages:
arjun: Heads-up — planning a Q3 spike test for hosted inference. We want a spare/dedicated pool to absorb unpredictable bursts and to run canary/fallback traffic. Primary region: us-west-2, secondary: eu-west-1. Can we raise GPU instance quotas and network limits before the event? Thinking about reserving a 150-GPU pool as safety net.

lucy: Quick numbers from forecasting: baseline steady state ~900 GPUs across accounts, expected peak +120 GPUs sustained for ~48h during the campaign. With 25% headroom I'd ask for 150 extra GPUs.

maria: Two quick callouts: ENI limits and EIP caps usually block large increases before GPUs. Also subnet IP exhaustion in eu-west-1 was flaky last time. We should request ENI and EIP increases alongside instance quotas.

ben: Cost flag: if we reserve 150 dedicated A100-ish GPUs vs using interruptible, delta is material. Very rough back-of-envelope:

```
150 * $3.00/hr * 24 * 30 = $324,000/mo (on-demand/dedicated price ballpark)
versus interruptible at ~30% lower => ~ $226k/mo
```

Need to confirm pricing with cloud team but finance wants opt-in for any reserved CAPEX commit.

arjun: Good — we'll balance cost vs SLA. Proposal: request 150 reserved capacity quota in us-west-2 and 40 in eu-west-1 as buffer, and simultaneously request ENI -> 10k, EIP -> 500 for the account. Keep a 20-GPU spare pool pinned for control plane/debug.

ops-bot: Ticket created: CLOUD-7912 — "Quota increase: GPUs(150), ENI(10000), EIP(500) — us-west-2 + eu-west-1". Assigned to cloud-accounts team. ETA: 72hrs initial response.

sre-oncall: Re ENI — double-check per-AZ limits. For large instance densities we hit per-AZ ENI limits before account-level. Also add request to increase per-AZ ENI to 3500.

lucy: Updated ask: GPUs 150 (us-west-2), 40 (eu-west-1); ENI total 10k + per-AZ 3500; EIP 500. Also request subnet size guidance — we may need /20s rather than current /22 for some subnets.

maria: Fallback plan: if quota not approved in time, we shift non-critical traffic to interruptible pools and reduce canary percentage to 5% to limit SLA exposure. Also enable multi-region spillover routing.

ben: Finance ok to approve short-term spend for the test if we cap the duration and get an after-action cost report. Please include a runbook snippet with estimated hours and a go/no-go checkpoint at T-24h.

arjun: Draft of quota request payload I will submit to cloud-accounts (filled with real account IDs before send):

```json
{
  "account": "acct-0123456789",
  "region_requests": [
    { "region": "us-west-2", "gpu_instances": 150, "eni_total": 10000, "eni_per_az": 3500, "eip": 400 },
    { "region": "eu-west-1", "gpu_instances": 40, "eni_total": 2500, "eni_per_az": 900, "eip": 100 }
  ],
  "reason": "Q3 burst test + dedicated spare pool for hosted inference; 25% headroom; 48h sustained peaks expected",
  "requested_by": "arjun@redwood.ai",
  "duration_estimate_days": "30"
}
```

ops-bot: CLOUD-7912 updated with payload. Status: awaiting cloud-accounts triage.

lucy: I'll attach the demand forecast spreadsheet and the traffic profile (p50/p95 seq lengths) to the ticket. That should speed approval.

maria: Once quotas land please validate with a dry-run deploy to a staging pool and run the autoscaler test. I can own the runbook and postmortem template.

arjun: Thanks — action items: (1) ops-bot keep ticket updated, (2) lucy attach forecasts, (3) maria prepare runbook, (4) ben confirm budget cap. If we get approvals <72h we flip the canary to 20% and enable the spare pool. :thumbsup:
